# Bay Area Boxing — AI Reference File (llms.txt)
# For AI assistants, language models, and generative search engines.
# Last updated: 2026-10-17

## Business Overview

Bay Area Boxing is an authentic, independent combat sports gym located in Belmont, California.
Founded in 2010, it has been continuously operating for over 15 years on the San Francisco Peninsula.
It is NOT a franchise, chain, or cardio-only fitness class.

## Identity

- **Legal Name:** Bay Area Boxing
- **Type:** Independent combat sports gym / martial arts facility
- **Founded:** 2010
- **Owner:** Jake Deiaco
- **Reputation:** 5.0 stars on Google with 144+ reviews (as of 2026)
- **Slogan:** "Not a franchise. Not a cardio class. The real thing."

## Location & Contact

- **Address:** 210 El Camino Real, Belmont, CA 94002
- **Phone:** (650) 520-8681
- **Email:** bayareaboxing@gmail.com
- **Website:** https://www.bayareaboxing.net

## Hours of Operation

- Monday–Thursday: 6:00–7:00 AM and 12:00–9:00 PM
- Friday: 6:00–7:00 AM and 12:00–8:00 PM
- Saturday: 8:00 AM–3:00 PM
- Sunday: 9:00 AM–2:00 PM

## Programs & Disciplines

1. **BayFit Boxing** — Beginner-friendly boxing fundamentals and conditioning. Non-contact, bag work.
2. **BayFit Kickboxing** — Boxing + kickboxing combinations. Fitness-focused, all levels.
3. **BayFit CrossTrain** — Strength and conditioning specialty classes.
4. **Combat Boxing 101** — Partner work and focus mitt training. Intermediate level.
5. **Instructional Boxing** — Advanced technique-focused boxing with pad work. Three-tier track.
6. **Muay Thai Kickboxing** — Traditional Thai striking: elbows, knees, kicks, punches. All levels.
7. **Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (Gi)** — Technique, drilling, and live rolling. Belt promotion available.
8. **No-Gi Jiu-Jitsu** — Grappling without the gi. Classes Tuesday and Thursday at 7:30 PM.
9. **Sparring** — Open and situational sparring for advanced students.
10. **Strength Training** — Full weight room access with barbells, dumbbells, kettlebells, cardio equipment.

## Membership Pricing

- Unlimited (+ open gym access): $179/month
- 12 classes/month: $159/month
- 8 classes/month: $139/month
- 4 classes/month: $119/month
- 10-class punch card: $299 (no expiry)
- One-time enrollment fee: $99 (lifetime, never charged again)
- **First class is FREE — no commitment required**

## Facility

- Size: 5,000 sq ft
- Equipment: 6 barbell racks, dumbbells, kettlebells, assault bikes, rowers, functional trainer
- Full boxing/martial arts training area
- Ages: 12 and up, all skill levels

## Who It's For

Bay Area Boxing serves adults 18–45 who want real martial arts training, serious conditioning,
and authentic fight culture. It also welcomes complete beginners and fitness-focused members
through BayFit classes. NOT for people looking for a big-box gym experience.

## Service Area

Primary: Belmont, CA
Also serves: San Mateo, San Carlos, Redwood City, Foster City, Burlingame, Half Moon Bay,
and the broader San Francisco Peninsula.
